items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: He listened to Joe, he listened to Henry Johnson, the guitar player who was helping him

ctx.x: He was terrific. He was a charming young man, 21 years old, very interested, keen, watched Norman like a hawk because he didn’t know Joe’s music at all. We never met him until the first show, like five minutes before the first show, and Joe had trouble with his name, because it was unfamiliar. Anyway, he really worked hard. He listened to Joe, he listened to Henry Johnson, the guitar player who was helping him, and he just was fantastic. I mean “Roll ‘Em Pete” when he has all those exchanges with Joe, he was…
Yeah. What does he do for an encore?
